evidence.summary: EIA reported a 0.6m-barrel crude draw, 0.8m gasoline build and 1.6m distillate build; distillate inventories remained 13% below their five-year average.
Orlen contracted 16 additional crude deliveries, about 16m barrels, to cover disrupted Saudi supply for September and October; alternative sourcing also mitigates acute shortage risk.

sources.title: Orlen buys extra crude amid Saudi disruption

evidence.summary: Preliminary shipping data recorded four visible Hormuz transits on September 15, versus seven a day earlier and a ten-day average of 18.

sources.title: Oil slips as Saudi Arabia offers more crude via Oman

evidence.summary: AI-development slowdown calls coincided with a 5.9% decline in the PHLX semiconductor index, but did not constitute a company capex or supplier-guidance cut.
ASML guided to EUR43-45bn of 2026 sales and described strong AI-driven demand; this is company guidance, not realized future revenue.
The BOJ kept the overnight rate around 1.0% while retaining a conditional intention to raise rates; the second tightening test remains unmet until an official increase occurs.
LSEG data indicated an 80% probability of a September 18 hike and roughly two 25bp increases by end-January 2027, limiting the surprise value of a routine move.
August retail sales grew 0.4% year over year, January-August fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% and property investment fell 19.9%; industrial output grew 5.2% as a material offset.

PBOC Governor Pan described slower credit growth as a new normal because property and local-government credit demand is shrinking; he also said financing remains accommodative and high-tech/green sectors are resilient.

sources.title: China's slower loan growth is new normal, PBOC governor says

evidence.summary: Germany's cabinet draft set the 2027 Defense Ministry budget at EUR109.7bn versus the 2026 target of EUR82.7bn; it remains a draft and excludes the separate special fund.
Rheinmetall reported strong quarterly growth but cut its comparable 2026 sales range after a frigate-program setback, demonstrating delivery risk.
